the-forester-backpack-duffle-bag.html:
One bag, three ways to carry it. The Forester is a leather travel duffle that switches between a top-handle duffle, a hands-free backpack and a cross-body sling, so it works for a weekend away, a business trip, the gym or a day outdoors.

Three carry modes

  • Top-handle mode: classic duffle carry for a smart look
  • Backpack mode: adjustable straps for hands-free long hauls
  • Cross-body sling mode: quick access on the move

Details

  • Genuine leather
  • Spacious main compartment with a slim profile
  • Colours: Brown, Crazy Horse, Tan and Black

Who it is for

For travellers, gym-goers and professionals who want one bag instead of three, and a strong gift for a man who travels.

Care

Wipe with a soft dry cloth and keep it out of heavy rain. If it gets stained, clean it gently as soon as you can; for deep cleaning, use a professional leather cleaner. Do not wash, bleach, iron or tumble dry. Condition the leather every few months and stuff the bag lightly when stored so it keeps its shape.

Questions we get

Is it cabin size?
Message us on WhatsApp with your airline and we will send the exact measurements.

Which colour ages best?
Crazy Horse and Tan show the most patina over time; Black stays the most uniform.
